source.title: Nacreous Pigment — LotzBoi community Milling Guide, Quality Control
source.author: LotzBoi

notes: Source states its Nacreous Pigment skill bands apply to all Khaz Algar herb/pigment families; this row applies that single claim to Mycobloom, not an independently observed cohort. Output identity 222618 and quality rank 1 independently cross-checked on https://goldcap.gg/retail/us/items/222618. Effective milling skill is the proposed variable, not input herb rank: all three input rank IDs are included, and profession tool/gear can change that skill. Community-reported rule only; thresholds not Blizzard/in-client verified. No observed operations, yield probability, Resourcefulness basis, or total units; no frozen prices. For rank 1 the upper bound is material, not a minimum. Orbinid/Blossom output quality IDs descend by rank, contrary to older provisional sequential assumptions.
requires: Community guide claims effective Khaz Algar milling skill 0–252 produces Nacreous Pigment quality rank 1. For rank 1, this is an upper-bound band (<=252), not a null/yield-zero rule; actual client skill, specialty and tool qualifiers must be verified.
